title: feat(messaging): org:members reaches every member of the emitting organization, and role:/team: read every member
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu3fM4vyqPaHhqDwy7WEqQAh)_

Refs #32445 (PR 1 of 2: audience selector)

Clause-②: yes
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: follow-up #32785

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：新增收件人写法 `org:members`，`emit()` 或 flow 的 `notify` 节点写它，就发给发信组织的全部成员（没有角色、角色不在内置四种之内的成员也算），分页读到底并在日志里记人数；另外 `role:`/`team:` 去掉了 1 万人的静默上限，这是行为变化：以前超过 1 万人的部分被悄悄丢掉，现在全部送达。
- 为什么改：裁决 6810324463 选 A 的第一期；此前要发全组织只能把四个角色全列上，无角色成员会被漏掉且没有任何提示。
- 风险与回滚：组织只取 emit 自带的 organizationId（与 `role:` 同源），从不读字符串里的组织；没带组织时解析为 0 人并告警，不做全表扫描；`org:` 下其他写法一律告警并解析为 0 人。@mention 闸门与 notify 的邮箱判定同步认这个前缀。无 Setup 界面、无权限改动；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/services/service-messaging/src/recipient-resolver.ts`（`resolveOrganizationMembers` 与分页 `memberUserIds`）、`packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/mention-recipient-gate.ts`（前缀清单一行）、`packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/notify-node.ts`（`mailedAddressOf` 正则一行）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-messaging exec vitest run src/recipient-resolver.test.ts src/notification-organization-follows-event.integration.test.ts`，应见 org:members 的 pin 全绿：A 组织 5 人（含无角色、自定义角色）全收到，B 组织的人一个没收到。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。
- 席位意见：席位复核通过（`Clause-②: yes` 的本席记录在 PR 评论，钉 `2daa9a73`）；skills 教学跟进卡 #32785；「用 emit 自带组织还是事件行盖章的组织」维持现状，随第二期再议；另有一项已私下转安全席。

## What changes

Ruling 6810324463 on #32445, letter A (the maintainer, verbatim: 「32443 直接做 B，其他同意」), first of its two PRs: the audience selector. The Setup action "Send in-app message" and its organization-administrator gate are PR 2; this PR adds no Setup action, no permission and no UI.

- **`@objectstack/service-messaging`: `org:members`, every member of the emitting organization.** `RecipientResolver` resolves `org:members` to every `sys_member` row of `ResolveContext.organizationId`, which `emit()` fills from `EmitInput.organizationId`, the same source `role:` has always scoped to. The member's `role` is not asked, so a member holding none, or one outside the built-in four, is reached. The read keeps the posture `role:` and `owner_of:` carry (`FAN_OUT_SYSTEM_CONTEXT`): the explicit system opt-in, projected to `user_id` alone, and nothing but recipient ids leaves the resolver. The organization filter is that read's only tenant boundary, so an emit that names no organization reads no membership at all: 0 recipients and a warning, never an unfiltered `sys_member` scan. The organization is never read from the audience string.
- **`org:` is reserved whole.** It is a closed literal, `ORGANIZATION_MEMBERS_AUDIENCE` (exported). Every other value under the prefix (`org:member`, `org:ID`, `org:members:ID`) resolves to nobody with a warning naming the one spelling, instead of being kept as a bare user id, the same treatment a malformed `owner_of:` value gets. Spelling precedent: the resolver's own `KIND:VALUE` selectors (`user:`, `role:`, `team:`, `owner_of:`), with `org` the platform's existing abbreviation in selector vocabulary (`org_membership_level`) and `members` the `sys_member` rows it reads.
- **Membership expansions page to the end.** One helper, `memberUserIds`, reads `org:members`, `role:` and `team:` in pages of `MEMBERSHIP_PAGE_SIZE` (1,000) rows ordered by `id` until a short page (`membershipPageSize` overrides it; the tests shrink it). `org:members` logs the count it resolved at `info`. `role:` and `team:` used to read one page of `limit: 10000` and drop the rest without a word; they now reach a larger membership in full. That is a behaviour change for an organization, role or team past 10,000 members, in the direction of delivering what the audience names.
- **`@objectstack/service-automation`: the `notify` node's written-address screen.** `mailedAddressOf` mirrors the resolver to decide which recipients reach the mail as an address. Its prefix test gains `org`, so an `org:` value is handed to the resolver as a selector, as `role:`, `team:` and `owner_of:` already were, instead of being refused or mailed as an address. `recipients: 'org:members'` needs no other change: the node already passes the run's organization (else the organization of the record the notification is about) to `emit()`.
- **`@objectstack/plugin-audit`: the `@mention` gate's list of expanding prefixes.** `NON_USER_PREFIXES` gains `org:`, so it stays in step with the resolver: a mention of an `org:` value names no person and notifies nobody, refused by the prefix list as `role:` / `team:` / `owner_of:` are.
- **Docs.** `content/docs/automation/flows.mdx` teaches `org:members` in the `notify` recipients paragraph, beside `team:ID`: who it reaches, where the organization comes from, and what an `org:` value that is not the selector does. The page names no `role:` selector, as before: `check:role-word` (ADR-0090 D3) keeps that word out of documentation prose, and the first draft of this paragraph tripped it. JSDoc on `AudienceSpec`, `EmitInput.organizationId`, `ResolveContext` and `FAN_OUT_SYSTEM_CONTEXT` names all the selectors.

No `packages/spec` change: `notify.recipients` is a string slot, and nothing in the spec or the lint enumerates audience prefixes, so the selector needs no schema shape and the PR stays in `domain:server`.

## Tests

- `recipient-resolver.test.ts`, two new top-level describes over `membershipTable`, a fake that honours `where`, `orderBy`, `offset`, `limit` and `fields`:
  - organization A holds the four built-in roles, a member with no role and one with `sales_rep`: all six resolve; B's member does not, and `org_b`'s own read reaches only B's;
  - the read is `sys_member`, `where: { organization_id }` and nothing else, `fields: ['user_id']`, `{ context: { isSystem: true } }`;
  - page size 2: all six members over pages at offsets 0, 2, 4, 6, every page ordered by `id`, and the count logged;
  - no organization (absent or empty): 0 recipients, a warning, and no `sys_member` read;
  - `org:member`, `org:org_b`, `org:` and `org:members:org_b`: 0 recipients, four warnings, no read;
  - a page that fails: the selector resolves to 0 with a warning, the rest of the audience survives;
  - `role:` and `team:` past the first page (five rows, pages of 2), and the default page size with bad overrides.
- `notification-organization-follows-event.integration.test.ts`, new top-level describe on a real `ObjectQL` over `SqlDriver` (better-sqlite3), `single` posture, two organizations, the platform's `SysMember`: `emit({ audience: 'org:members', organizationId: 'org_a' })` with pages of 2 delivers 5 of 5 and writes an inbox row for exactly org A's five members (owner, member, admin, no role, and a `sales_rep` row seeded through the driver, since the engine refuses that value on write today), all owned by `org_a`; the same emit with no organization is refused at the event write (ADR-0131 D9) and delivers nothing.
- `notify-written-address-channels.integration.test.ts` (real `MessagingService`, inbox and email channels, the notify node): `recipients: 'org:members'` from a run in `org_1` reaches its two members' inboxes and not `org_2`'s; `org:exec@company.example` on an inbox node and on an inbox + email node is neither refused as an address nor mailed.
- `mention-recipient-gate.integration.test.ts`: `org:members`, `user:org:members` and `org:anything` as mentions notify nobody, and the withheld log names `not_a_user` with no user id for each: the prefix list refused them before any read.

<details><summary>Ablations</summary>

Each through `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on committed head `d8102f22` (anchor hit 1 → 0 on disk), the restore proved by the blob hash equal to HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`. No dist rebuild was needed: every pin below imports the mutated module from source.

1. The tenant filter dropped (`{ organization_id: organizationId }` → `{}` in `resolveOrganizationMembers`): 6 failed / 26 passed, among them `never reaches a member of another organization` and the end-to-end `delivers to all five members of org_a, and to no one in org_b`; restored, blob `3e46f2b3`.
2. The paging loop cut to one page (`if (page.length < this.membershipPageSize) return [...ids];` → `return [...ids];`): 5 failed / 27 passed (the `org:members`, `role:` and `team:` paging pins, the failing-page pin and the end-to-end); restored, blob `3e46f2b3`.
3. `'org:'` taken out of `NON_USER_PREFIXES`: the prefix pin red (`not_a_user` expected, `cannot_read_source` received), 1 failed / 29 passed; restored, blob `75787585`.
4. `org` taken out of `mailedAddressOf`'s prefix test: the inbox-node cell red (the node refused `org:exec@company.example` as a written-out address), 1 failed / 17 passed; restored, blob `8f949518`.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **The organization is the producer's, as for `role:`.** `emit()` passes `EmitInput.organizationId` to the resolver, not the organization the engine stamps on the event row when the producer names none. Under `single` with one organization, an emit with no organization is owned by the Default Organization, yet `org:members` resolves to nobody there, with a warning; a `notify` node in a run that carries no organization and is about no record is that case. Passing the stored event's organization would close it, but it would also change the scope of `role:` in the same case, so this PR leaves it to the seat as a follow-up rather than widening the change. The Setup action of PR 2 always passes the acting administrator's organization.
- **`org:` was not reserved before.** A recipient string beginning `org:` used to be kept as a bare user id (or looked up as an address); it now reaches nobody unless it is `org:members`. No generated user id or real address takes that shape.
- The Studio flow inspector's recipients field (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/FlowRecipientsField.tsx`) classifies `role:` / `owner_of:` / `user:` values; `org:members` falls to its generic branch there. It is UI, outside this PR, and the ui card for the Setup dialog can carry it.

## Verification

All readings local, on this branch after `git merge origin/main` (`d257c4a7`); every family CI runs is the PR's own check-runs.

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on head `2daa9a73`: 101 derived families, every one `exit 0`; `--ran` reconciliation: 101 derived, 101 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. A full `pnpm build` ran first, and the positive-control commit of `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` was fetched, so no gate answered exit 3.
- The first pass, on `d257c4a7`, went red on three gates, each fixed on this branch: `check:engine-double-contract` and `check:where-matcher` (the new membership doubles: the resolver's now restates `find` alone over the file's existing double, and both refuse a `where` combinator) and `check:role-word` (the docs paragraph; see Docs above).
- Full suites under the verify lock, on `d257c4a7`: `@objectstack/service-messaging` 69 files / 901 tests passed; `@objectstack/service-automation` 278 / 3790; `@objectstack/plugin-audit` 88 / 1422. The two later commits change only the two new test doubles, the docs paragraph and nothing else; the two test files they touch pass again on `2daa9a73` (26/26 and 18/18).
- `pnpm --filter PKG run typecheck` for the three packages: exit 0 each.
- `pnpm lint` (eslint over the whole repository, `--no-inline-config`) on `2daa9a73`: exit 0.
- No dogfood battery: no `!` in the title and no `(narrowing)` arm.
